purpose: Define the reproducible molecule-level identity comparison and the single-source feature branch required before a PCQM4Mv2 P1 adapter is designed.

frozen_source_association.csv_row_identity: official data.csv.gz zero-based row; CSV idx must be audited as equal to that row index before full release
forbidden: CSV atom order as an atom-to-atom correspondence

projection.why: RDKit default RemoveHs preserves a stereo-defining explicit H. The OGB SDF represents this H explicitly while the official CSV SMILES normally makes it implicit; the minimal override removes that representational false positive without broad isotope/query/mapped-atom removal.

keys.strict_isomeric: SHA-256 of RDKit canonical isomeric SMILES after the locked projection
keys.connectivity: SHA-256 of RDKit canonical non-isomeric SMILES after the locked projection

classification_policy.strict_isomeric_match: eligible to be considered by the later full adapter, subject to every other release gate

stereo_or_isomeric_representation_mismat.exception_rule: A later SDF-self-consistent 2D+3D-only ablation may retain it only with a separately frozen policy and comparative evaluation; it must never be silently mixed into the primary release.

single_source_feature_branch.feature_mol: the post-projection SDF RDKit Mol for one admitted SDF ordinal
single_source_feature_branch.invariant: All atom-indexed arrays must have the feature_mol atom count and use its atom order. Official CSV SMILES is an identity companion only, never an atom-order source.
forbidden: mixing CSV-derived atom indices with SDF-derived coordinates
computing E3FP from a separately embedded SMILES conformer
silently padding an invalid mapping into a geometry target

bounded_evidence.scope: first 1000 official train SDF ordinals against their train-split companion CSV rows
bounded_evidence.interpretation: This permits a full remote identity/reject-ledger design only. It neither proves the full corpus nor admits P1.

full_pass_prerequisites: archive and companion source locks verify remotely
CSV idx-to-row-index association is fully audited
SDF ordinal/title/train-position association is fully audited
one immutable membership manifest and reject ledger are written before any LMDB release
downstream validation/test identity-overlap policy is executed and records zero overlap before admission
